verdict.rationale: Linear supports natural-language interaction extensively: users can @mention Linear Agent, describe jobs in plain language for Loops, use 'Write with Agent' to draft updates, and delegate issues via comments in natural language (linear-docs-11, -19, -36, -41, -68). This is well documented across multiple first-party changelog entries and the agents.md docs, but missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of natural-language command accuracy or limitations, and no dedicated NL command palette/chat interface separate from agent-delegation workflows.
